subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only scope in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 fully resolve this issue, or must `channel` also gain a dynamically derived enum?
rationale: The description is a narrow repair, but enum behavior changes the model-facing contract and must preserve dynamically registered plugin ids without loading full channel runtimes.

options.title: Description only
options.body: Refresh and land the existing PR, treating clear provider/plugin-id wording plus regression coverage as sufficient while leaving the value extensible.

options.title: Require dynamic enum
options.body: Expand the implementation only after defining a lightweight registry-backed enum that includes installed plugin ids and aliases.

recommendation.title: Description only
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the existing PR, treating clear provider/plugin-id wording plus regression coverage as sufficient while leaving the value extensible.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the prior scope analysis and have the strongest identified history on the channel terminology and current message-tool surface.
